{"id":1632560762,"question_id":3629,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 2 months","timestamp":1747117920,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1632560762/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Total Characters in String After Transformations I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int MOD  = 100000007;\n   \n    int solve(char ch , int t)\n    {\n        //base case \n        if(t == 0) return 1;\n\n        if(ch == 'z')\n        {\n            return solve('a' , t-1) + solve('b' , t-1);\n        }\n        else\n        {\n            return solve(ch + 1 , t-1);\n        }\n    }\n\n    int lengthAfterTransformations(string s, int t) {\n        int total = 0;\n        for(auto ch : s)\n        {\n            total = (total + solve(ch , t )) % MOD ;\n        }\n        return total;\n        \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"total-characters-in-string-after-transformations-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":587}
